newsitem.title: USA: Ford to sell five alternative-fuel vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Ford to sell five alternative-fuel vehicles.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Friday it will sell five new alternative-fuel vehicles in the 1998 model year and plans to invest more than $1 billion in the next five years for such vehicles and emission research.

The five new vhicles include bi-fuel natural gas versions of the Ford F-Series pickup and Econoline van, Ford said. It also includes bi-fuel propane models of the F-Series and Econoline van as well as the Ranger electric vehicle.
In total, Ford will sell 11 vehicles powered by natural gas, propane, alcohol fuels or electricity, the company said.
